title: New E9/E22 balance keys load via legacy jint — silent float truncation and i32 wraparound slip past the >0 guard
detail: The new 3.3 keys coerce through unguarded i32 casts: a decimal (6.5) silently truncates, and values >= 2^31 wrap — 4294967301 becomes 5 and passes the <=0 guard, silently corrupting the E9/E22 bounds the contention story depends on. jint_strict exists for exactly this.
recommended_fix: Load lane_queue_packets/pool_max_packets via jint_strict (or range-check before the cast) so decimals and out-of-i32 values fail fast, matching the 3.1 integer-only bar.
